Text: {"query":"Hit a bit of a sticky wicket last night when my tin of milk tea ran dry halfway through a batch of scones. Right then, first up is milk tea, and I'd love a tin or pack that weighs 360 g or more, so there's plenty to see me through the scone season. I can go up to 445 pence on it, no higher, so let's keep it inside that boundary. Do show me only the ones you can actually send out, as anything unavailable is a dropped catch for me. After 2 messages from you, I stop replying. I like a cuppa while I bake on Sunday afternoons, and the family drops in for a slice around four. Each tool call counts as a step, and 35 steps are yours.
